**Selected:** Cuong–Kien–Matsuoka–Truong Conjecture 1.1, stated in Kien–Matsuoka–Ozaki, *Pseudo-Frobenius numbers and defining ideals in stretched numerical semigroup rings*, arXiv:2501.06415, latest v2 (14 January 2025). For EVERY minimally n-generated numerical semigroup H, n>=3, over a field k, the following are equivalent: (i) its defining toric ideal is generated by the maximal minors of a 2-by-n matrix of positive-degree homogeneous elements; (ii) after permuting generators it is generated by the minors with columns (X_i^{c_i},X_{i+1}^{d_{i+1}}), positive integer exponents and cyclic indices; (iii) PF(H) is an arithmetic progression of length n-1. The unrestricted implication (iii)=>(ii) is the target; neither stretched nor uniqueness hypotheses may be added. The ordinary n=3 theorem is classical and uncredited. Source v1 and actual latest v2 Conjecture1.1 and Theorem1.2 bodies were read. No journal reference is listed in the inspected arXiv metadata; this does not certify absence of a published version.

There is no continuity, density, moment, finite-support or bounded-support hypothesis on mu. C is approximately 0.4006953723, not exactly the decimal 0.400695. Proposition 4.1 supplies the lower bound; the unproved task is the universal upper bound. The unique maximizing p is the root in (0,1) of 2-2p-3p²-4p³+p⁴=0. A numerical semigroup S is a cofinite additive submonoid of the NONNEGATIVE INTEGERS containing 0. Its multiplicity is min(S minus {0}); its Frobenius number is max(Z minus S). Its unique minimal generating set is msg(S), and μ(S) counts generators strictly GREATER than F(S). I(m,F) comprises all S with multiplicity m, Frobenius F and μ(S)>0; L(m,F) has the same invariants and μ(S)=0. These refer to internal/leaf status in the FULL numerical-semigroup tree, not the restricted enumeration tree (Remark 40). All admissible F are positive. Counts are finite since S is determined by S intersect [1,F]. There is no characteristic or field parameter. No fixed genus, embedding dimension, symmetric/pseudosymmetric restriction or asymptotic qualification is allowed. The endpoint m=F+1 is included. Conjectures 25, 35 and the genus/Fibonacci questions are not additional fresh slots.
